Retains immutable source checks, comparison snapshots, and encrypted restricted
captures under `data/verification`. The archive branch is the comparison state
for the next independent run while this PR awaits review.

No endorsement ledger, source panel, scoring, release, or production change is
approved by these observations. Review source changes through the finite daily
verification tasks. Human baseline attestations and manual verification records
must receive normal repository review. This workflow does not queue auto-merge.

Refs #497
